name: starfield_mystic_two_enchantments_leaving_at_once_give_two_counters
notes: Printed: 'Whenever an enchantment you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature.' One trigger for each enchantment, also when they go in the same moment. Two Pacifisms of seat 0 enchant the opponent's Bear; when it dies both Auras are put into the graveyard together by one state-based action (CR 704.5m): two triggers, two counters, the Mystic is 4/4.
